demonstrates: What a freshly created environment's to-do list opens with -- a preview, a fresh clone, a stage nobody has written in yet. Tasks chosen to be LOOKED AT rather than asserted about: both states side by side, the newest-first order visible, and characters outside ASCII surviving to the screen. Listed in ADDING order; the seeder adds all five, each not done, and only then marks the done one through the marking route, because a task is never born done. Every text is one line and well under the bound, because a task padded to two hundred characters is a list nobody can read.
